instruction: Open the 'case study.docx' file in the 'students work' folder on the Desktop and change the document title from 'Case Study' to 'Digital Transformation Case Study'.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/students work/The literature reviews of weekly readings.docx

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to fix APA 7th edition references in case study.docx. It navigated the desktop, opened the students work folder, opened the document, scrolled to the References section, checked paragraph formatting, and began manually italicizing journal titles one by one. Ran out of 50 turns before completing all changes.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate desktop icons, open folders, double-click to open files in LibreOffice, scroll through documents, select text, apply formatting (Ctrl+I for italics), use Format menu, use keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+End, Ctrl+S), interact with dialogs
metadata.failure_analysis: Task was too complex - required fixing multiple APA formatting issues across 9 references (italics, DOIs, date formats, etc.). Agent used inefficient one-by-one GUI approach and exhausted turn limit.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed to a simple text replacement task on the same document. The model demonstrated ability to open case study.docx and edit text. Changing the title is a single find-and-replace operation within the model's capabilities.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening case study.docx and changing the first paragraph from 'Case Study' to 'Digital Transformation Case Study'. Evaluator reads the docx file via python-docx and checks the first non-empty paragraph text.

scoring_breakdown.title_text: 1.0 - First paragraph reads 'Digital Transformation Case Study'
